notes.title: 【Known Issue】Mac version unable to use Steam Cloud Save
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We’ve identified a problem where Steam Cloud Save is currently not working on the Mac version of the game. This means your progress won’t sync to the cloud and may be lost if switching devices.

We have located the issue and are actively working on a fix. In the meantime, we recommend:

Avoid switching devices while playing on Mac.

Manually back up your save files regularly.

We’ll post an update as soon as the issue is resolved. Thank you for your patience and support!

—The This Month’s Stay: Hotel Tycoon Dev Team
